title: DIFFPO: Diffusion-styled Preference Optimization for Efficient Inference-Time Alignment of Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on the alignment of Large Language Models with human values and intentions. It evaluates its proposed method using the HH-RLHF (Helpfulness and Harmlessness) benchmark, which is a standard metric for ethical and safe alignment. Additionally, it contains an appendix section specifically dedicated to 'LLM Pluralism and Fairness' that discusses reflecting diverse human values.
